what: MACHAMP round 3 (generation 5), written 2026-09-25 BEFORE the deep-value run, the fits and the first SPRT game. It applies the four changes the gen4 ablation pointed to (docs/_reports/2026-09-25-selfplay-v0.md §11), all agreed by the coordinator.
champion: solver/machamp/league/gen0-r2.json (MAG v1 + DODUO v1 + PORYGON2 v0; MILTANK k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, 1000 ms, depth 0)
candidate: solver/machamp/league/gen5.json — the champion's search settings, gen5's nets

data.pooled: every self-play round so far on this release, unweighted: solver/out/selfplay/eaa5becc54eb/{gen0, gen1, r2-sp0, r2-sp1} (1600 + 1600 + 1000 + 1000 games). Round 1's decisions with a matrix more than 50% empty stay excluded from DODUO (the build rule).
data.new_selfplay: the champion keeps playing (r3-sp0, seed 104, the round-2 league and settings) in the background while the SPRT runs, for the next round; it is NOT used by gen5

porygon2.target: 0.5 x game outcome z + 0.5 x v_deep, v_deep from solver/machamp/deep_value.js: the game replayed exactly, then 4 rollouts per position of 3 turns in which BOTH sides sample their joint from DODUO v1 (the frozen human clone), then the game's result if it ended, else frozen PORYGON2 v0. Never the search's depth-0 root value (the trained net's own opinion one turn ahead). Rollout seed 1.
porygon2.training: unchanged from rounds 1-2 otherwise (warm start from v0, human positions 1:1, 6 epochs, lr 5e-4; the same epoch selection)

doduo: the strong pull that Candidate B used: beta 0.7 (target 0.3 search mix + 0.7 DODUO v1), human-click weight 3.0, 3 epochs, lr 3e-4, warm start from v1, same selection rule

gates.G_pory2_human: unchanged: 95% upper bound of (new - PORYGON2 v0) held-out human log-loss <= +0.004
gates.G_beats_previous: REPLACED by an SPRT: elo0 = 0, elo1 = +20, alpha = beta = 0.05, normal-approximation GSPRT on PAIR scores (one battle seed, seats swapped), bounds ln(beta/(1-alpha)) = -2.944 and ln((1-beta)/alpha) = +2.944, evaluated after every pair in pair-index order, stopped by the bound only; budget 2000 games (1000 pairs); no bound by then = INCONCLUSIVE. Pairs cycle over the 173 TEST team pairs of data/team-pool-frozen-regmc, pair i on battle seed 9001 x 100000 + i (solver/mew/play.js match mode). 3 workers, frozen release, 1000 ms per decision on both sides. PASS iff H1.
gates.G_not_lose_clone: unchanged: 200 games vs the human clone, Wilson 95% upper bound >= 0.5
